_note: The artist page, 2026-09-20, from the vendor-network handoff as Daniel ruled on it the same day: the handoff's copy is not ratified, the page is drafted to the global copy law (the tells catalog, BASE-VOICE, the Signet rulings) and he edits it in CopyDesk after. Indexed, and he also hands the link over face to face. Not /artists/, because that directory holds the named acts' pages (Tejas, Tony Medina, Firstwater) and a client trimming one of those URLs must not land on a sign-up page. No terms on the page: commission, exclusivity and non-circumvention are one-to-one after a fit, and 'representation is non-exclusive' is the one relationship line that publishes (Daniel: correct). The genre list is wider than the roster on purpose ('include other genres that aren't currently on the roster'). The CTA is the Google Form in site.json brand.forms.artist, owned by Daniel's own account; rates are asked in the form and never publish back. No nav key: the page is for musicians, not buyers.
